title: Mako-san wa Shindemo Jiritsu Shinai
titleNative: マコさん死んでも自立しない
synopsis: It's been a whole year since Rin Touno moved to a boarding house in Tokyo in order to attend high school. Back then, the landlord made Rin an offer he couldn’t refuse: if he looked after the landlord’s granddaughter, he wouldn’t have to pay any rent. However, said granddaughter, Mako Kurihashi, turned out to be a sloppy 20-year-old college student who’s not only completely incapable of taking care of herself, but also repeatedly teases Rin for being younger than her! Despite this, though, Rin fell madly in love with Mako at first sight, and he's been taking care of her ever since they began living together. And little did he know that Mako feels the exact same way about him.

synopsis: A man works in an exploitative company, and his only joy in life is playing the hack-and-slash game "Brave of Kingdom" when he gets home from work. But one day, when playing the game, he sees something strange, and the next thing he knows, he is inside the world of the game, with the familiar adjutant character Selina before him in her familiar uniform. He has transformed into the game's evil general Zeorg, with his muscular build and full beard, along with his doomed destiny to be mowed down by the game's hero, along with the rest of the game's mooks. Using his survival skills in his exploitative workplace, and his knowledge of the game, Zeorg is determined to avoid a bad ending. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

synopsis: Tachibana Hinata and Jinguji Tsukasa are two young men who have been friends since childhood. After a disaster of a singles mixer, they’re sent flying into another world by a mysterious being–and now Tachibana is a beautiful blonde girl! When Jinguji angrily demands that they be returned home and go back to normal, they get cursed, and the only way out is for them to go on a quest and defeat the demon king. But…now the two friends can’t stop thinking about how hot the other is. Will they save the world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Ranked 19th place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

When no one bids on him and he’s queued for disposal, he is rescued in the nick of time by Marquess Basam. His troubles never seem to end, as he struggles to survive! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
